verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an official CLI, abctl, for deploying/running Airbyte anywhere Docker runs (airbyte-docs-13), and PyAirbyte is explicitly positioned for AI/Python developers (airbyte-docs-1, airbyte-probe-rt-1), showing some official CLI-adjacent tooling usable by AI-native users. However, none of these are framed or documented as an AI-native CLI for agentic pipeline management—abctl is deployment-only, PyAirbyte is a Python library not a CLI, and the AI-agent integration path is the MCP server (a different axis), not a CLI. Missing for 10: a dedicated, documented CLI tool explicitly designed for AI-native/agentic workflows (e.g., triggering syncs, managing connections) beyond deployment tooling.
